jei.reverie.bed.1: Use the Dreamweaver's Bed to enter a creative reflection of the Overworld while your survival inventory is safely stored.
jei.reverie.bed.2: Beds belong to their creators. Guests normally require the owner to enter first and must offer an Amethyst Shard.
jei.reverie.bed.3: In the Reverie, use a Respawn Anchor on the bed to make it a permanent Dream Anchor.
jei.reverie.bed.4: If an interrupted transition leaves a recovery backup open, sneak-use your own bed twice to restore it safely.
jei.reverie.cage.1: Figment Cages permit summoned creatures to exist within their chunk-based range.
jei.reverie.cage.2: Charge one with Echo Shards to expand its range. Hold a cage or spawn egg to reveal its boundary.
